question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Orbit**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Orbit **means the path of a celestial object around a larger celestial body, such as a planet around a star. (एक बड़े खगोलीय पिंड के चारों ओर एक खगोलीय वस्तु का पथ)
 
• The word "orbit" can also be used metaphorically to refer to a regular or predictable course or pattern of activity.
